findings.issue: Minimum and Maximum Capacity Set to Zero
findings.risk: Setting both minimum and maximum capacity to zero will completely shut down the service during the scale-down period, which may not be desirable and can lead to service unavailability.
The schedule is hardcoded and does not adjust to daylight saving time, which may lead to incorrect scaling times depending on the time of year.
findings.remediation: Use a more dynamic approach to handle time zone changes, or clearly document the expectation that the schedule does not adjust for daylight saving time.
